door-close.label: A floor grid turns into a closed door
door-close.explanation: The Borg has a flow routed through a floor grid (flow value 50, knowledge recorded, stone-to-mud stamps set). Between two map passes the door on that grid closes. The original takes the grid's old wall state after overwriting it with the new feature, sees no change and keeps everything stale; the correction invalidates the flow (value 255), clears knowledge and resets the wizard-light and detect-walls stamps.

SETUP pass1 feat=1 flow=50 know=1 icky=1
SETUP seed=1000 class=Warrior level=1 depth=30 changed=1
  wall_change_invalidates_flow  MODE door-close
STATE flow=50 know=1 icky=1 wizard_light=1 detect_walls=1
OUTCOME invalidated=0 flow255=0

door-open.label: A closed door opens
door-open.explanation: The same grid changes from a closed door to floor. The flow value stays (only new walls get 255) but knowledge and the stamps are cleared in the corrected version; the original keeps everything stale.
